queries: should I send product data with the conversion
why add basket info to KST
can Kelkoo see which products were bought
content:
You can enrich your KST implementation by sending information about the products in each transaction.

Basket information helps Kelkoo Group understand which products generate sales, and enables additional performance optimisations.

How you implement it depends on how KST was installed — manually or via Google Tag Manager.

topic: Basket information for a manual installation
queries: how do I add basket data manually
what fields does the basket need
content:
For a manual installation, add a `basket` parameter to the `_kkstrack` variable on your order confirmation page, containing an array of all products in the transaction:

```
_kkstrack = {
  ...
  basket:  [{ productname: 'Man@@ubri ricoperti di spugna 1 kg x 2 pz ',
              productid: '1',
              quantity: '1',
              price: '4.2'
            },
            { productname: 'p2',
              productid: '2',
              quantity: '3',
              price: '8.6'
            },
            ...
            ]
  ...
};
```

All four fields are required for each product:

Field | Description
productname | Name of the product
productid | Unique identifier of the product
quantity | Number of units purchased
price | Unit price of the product

**Important:** `productid` should match the product identifier used in your Kelkoo Group offer feed — the EAN, SKU or another unique product ID. Using the same identifier lets Kelkoo Group match transactions to the corresponding products in your feed, enabling further performance optimisations.

topic: Basket information via Google Tag Manager
queries: how do I send products through GTM
GTM ecommerce data layer example for Kelkoo
what should the data layer contain for basket data
content:
If KST was installed through Google Tag Manager, your Data Layer must contain the product information for the transaction:

```
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
dataLayer.push({
  'transactionId':'1234',
  'transactionAffiliation':'Acme Clothing',
  'transactionTotal':38.26,
  'transactionTax':1.29,
  'transactionShipping':5,
  'transactionProducts':[{
    'sku':'DD44',
    'name':'T-Shirt',
    'category':'Apparel',
    'price':11.99,
    'quantity':1},
    {
    'sku':'AA345',
    'name':'Boots',
    'category':'Shoes',
    'price':99.99,
    'quantity':4
  }]
})
```

Make sure the product information your KST configuration needs is actually present in the Data Layer.

**Important:** the `sku` should match the product identifier in your Kelkoo Group offer feed — EAN, SKU or another unique product ID. Consistent identifiers let Kelkoo Group match purchased products to your feed and enable further optimisations.

topic: Passing the product ID / SKU to KST
queries: how do I pass the SKU
does KST support Google Analytics baskets
how do I send the EAN
content:
Ways to get the product ID / SKU to KST: - **GTM installation** — add the SKU in the GTM tag. - **Manual installation** — add the SKU to the js variable `_kkltrack` (`_kkltrack.sku`), as published in the documentation. - **Structured metadata** — if you already follow Google's requirements for structured product metadata (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/data-types/product#microdata), KST retrieves them automatically. topic: Reimplementing the Lead Tag: when it is appropriate
queries: can I implement the lead tag myself
should I write my own lead tag
alternative to the standard lead tag script
content:
This applies to merchants who cannot use the standard Kelkoo Group `leadtag.js` script and need to reproduce its essential behaviour in their own implementation.

For most integrations Kelkoo Group recommends the standard Lead Tag. Only implement the logic yourself if you have a specific technical requirement to do so.

custom code to set the kelkoo cookie

topic: The kk URL parameter and kelkooId
queries: where does the kk parameter come from
content:
Kelkoo Group automatically adds the `kk` URL parameter when a user clicks one of your ads.

Your Lead Tag implementation reads the value of `kk` and stores it as `kelkooId`.
